name: Angie Tribeca
description: Lone-wolf detective Angie Tribeca and a squad of committed LAPD detectives investigate the most serious cases, from the murder of a ventriloquist to a rash of baker suicides.

videos.title: The Binge-A-Thon Special
videos.overview: Remember how we did that 25-hour marathon for Angie Tribeca? Well, here are all the comedy bits we had in between the episodes so you can watch them in one place.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Angie Tribeca is assigned a new partner, Jay Geils, to find the mayor's blackmailer and bring him to justice.

videos.title: The Wedding Planner Did It
videos.overview: Tribeca tracks down a baker's murderer before anyone else gets hurt.

videos.title: The Famous Ventriloquist Did It
videos.overview: Tribeca delves into the salacious world of American ventriloquism to investigate a murder.

videos.title: The Thumb Affair
videos.overview: Tribeca and Geils search high and low for a missing priceless work of art.

videos.title: Commissioner Bigfish
videos.overview: Tribeca and Geils poke around into a prostitution ring, but the lieutenant is afraid of what they might uncover and orders them to stop.

videos.title: Ferret Royale
videos.overview: Illegal pet ferrets are leaking into California, so Tribeca and Geils follow a trail that leads them to a high stakes poker game.

videos.title: Tribeca's Day Off
videos.overview: Ordered to take a day off, Tribeca dabbles in civilian life, while Tanner and Geils solve a murder on a golf course.

videos.title: Murder in the First Class
videos.overview: Another dead passenger arrives at LAX, so the gang goes undercover aboard an airplane to catch the killer in the act.

videos.title: Inside Man
videos.overview: A band of British gangsters robs another bank, and after Tribeca and Geils infiltrate the gang, they somehow get stuck in prison.

videos.title: The One with the Bomb
videos.overview: Tribeca will stop at nothing to save a kidnapped Geils before time runs out.

videos.title: Fleas Don't Kill Me
videos.overview: A man is found dead in a dog park, and Lieutenant Atkins doesn't think Tribeca is ready for the case because she hates dogs and just woke up from a coma.

videos.title: Miso Dead
videos.overview: Tensions flare between Tribeca and Scholls after the skull of a missing sushi chef is fished out of the ocean. Why? Because they're in a love triangle with Geils. It actually has very little to do with the case.

videos.title: Beach Blanket Sting-O
videos.overview: Geils goes undercover as a lifeguard after a string of suspicious drownings, but Tribeca is worried that he's getting in too deep.

videos.title: You've Got Blackmail
videos.overview: A massive conspiracy is set in motion after a seedy dating website is hacked for seemingly vague reasons.

videos.title: A Coldie but a Goodie
videos.overview: Tribeca believes that a 102-year-old's death isn't as natural as everyone thinks, but her concerns aren't heard because of her probation.

videos.title: Organ Trail
videos.overview: Atkins assigns a romance novelist to aid Geils and Tribeca in their attempt to bust an organ thief at a local hospital. Why? Why not? Does anything have to make sense anymore? Or can shows just do whatever they want with no explanation?

videos.title: Boyz II Dead
videos.overview: Geils and Tanner investigate the mysterious death of a reunited boy band member while Tribeca finally meets with Sgt. Pepper. Why? Seemingly, he's connected to Mayhem Global, but what is Mayhem Global and why do they keep bringing it up?

videos.title: The Coast is Fear
videos.overview: A member of the Coast Guard is murdered, and somehow Tribeca and Geils connect it to Mayhem Global. Why? What is the point of all of this? What is it all leading to?

videos.title: Contains Graphic Designer Violence
videos.overview: When a graphic designer is found dead, all evidence points to Tribeca. Why?! What does it mean?! It's just needless cliffhanger after needless cliffhanger with absolutely no accountability for narrative satisfaction!

videos.title: Electoral Dysfunction
videos.overview: The thrilling conclusion to Season 2. Every question answered. Every twist explained. A logically and emotionally gratifying finale that is sure to silence all critics and guarantee a third season.

videos.title: Welcome Back, Blotter
videos.overview: Angie Tribeca retires to become a stay at home mom. Show’s over, right? Wrong. A trophy hunter goes missing and she’s back on the case, which will definitely take nine more episodes to solve.

videos.title: Murder Gras
videos.overview: Tribeca has a hunch that the trophy hunter hunter has struck again, this time in New Orleans. It’s all gators and gumbo as Tribeca heads to the Big Easy in hopes of catching the killer before he strikes again. But everything is not as it seems to be.

videos.title: Brockman Turner Overdrive
videos.overview: When a beloved college badminton star is the suspect of a hit-and-run, everyone turns a blind eye, because, as we all know, L.A.'s a badminton city. But not Tribeca and Geils, who find "fault" with the case and won't "let" it go.

videos.title: Turn Me On, Geils
videos.overview: A brilliant robotics specialist is found dead in his lab. No one knows who killed him, which makes Tribeca's job a lot harder. The only one who can offer any insight into the case is the victim's magnetic assistant, who takes a liking to Geils.

videos.title: This Sounds Unbelievable, but CSI: Miami Did It
videos.overview: Natalie Portman's in this one, but also a man falls from the sky and the team investigates a lead in space.

videos.title: Hey, I'm Solvin' Here!
videos.overview: When a middle-aged white man is murdered in New York, the team goes there based on Tribeca's belief that the serial killer they've been tracking is the culprit. No one's on board with her theory, but as the main character, she drives the plot.

videos.title: License to Drill
videos.overview: When a sultry woman convinces Geils to investigate whether her husband is having an affair, he dons his P.I. hat, which lands him in trouble. Think Chinatown, because that's where this story comes from.

videos.title: If You See Something, Solve Something
videos.overview: A naked woman crawls out of a child's backpack and doesn't remember a thing. Why? She couldn't tell you. Tribeca helps her trace her steps while Geils and Tanner track down a murderer on the run from prison.

videos.title: Germs of Endearment
videos.overview: When an outbreak of a lethal virus threatens to liquefy everyone in Los Angeles and perhaps the world, the team realizes this might be the season's serial killer's magnum opus.

videos.title: Go Get 'Em, Tiger
videos.overview: People are still solid, but Dr. Scholls turns up missing, and the serial killer is still on the loose. Meanwhile, Lt. Atkins has a beautiful outdoor wedding. Do the two converge? That would tie things up nicely in the end.

videos.title: The Force Wakes Up
videos.overview: After 20 years in prison, Angie is reunited with her old team and son A.J., now part of the Special Division Force. The teams first assignment is to infiltrate a hospital to find a potential assassin of French Ambassador, Pierre Cardin.

videos.title: Glitch Perfect
videos.overview: Tribeca is undercover as a high school glee club coach to stop a highly prolific distributor of malware and computer exploits. But first, her glee club must come in first place at their final competition.

videos.title: Joystick Luck Club
videos.overview: The team investigates an attack on popular E-Sports gamer, Bondevil. A.J. is sent to join and infiltrate the QuarkSpark team where he learns of a secret underground money laundering system within the E-Sports world.

videos.title: Just the Fat, Ma'am
videos.overview: Tribeca is sent undercover to investigate a string of dead models from “Popular Magazine.” The only catch, the fingerprints on all of the bodies belong to dead Peruvian men. The remainder of the team heads to Peru to investigate.

videos.title: Trader Foes
videos.overview: Angie and Team go undercover to infiltrate Lowercase Capital, a successful Wall Street-like corporation, in connection with the murder of an eccentric billionaire.

videos.title: Freezing Cold Prestige Drama
videos.overview: In Fargo, South Dakota, the team is tasked with waiting for the arrival of a certain truck, the contents of which are unknown to the team. Charo and AJ cover up an unfortunate incident which has ties to the mysterious arrival of the truck.

videos.title: Behind the Scandalabra
videos.overview: The team is recruited by the Vice President to cover up a Cabinet members extra-marital affair after the suitor mysteriously dies.

videos.title: Heading to the Legal Beagle
videos.overview: The team works alongside a victim suing a popular law office for covering up negligence at FarmTech, a farming company with an alleged pesticide problem.

videos.title: Irrational Treasures
videos.overview: Atkins' family secret leads the team on a race across the country to beat Pierre Cardin in stealing the Louisiana Purchase.

videos.title: Air Force Two
videos.overview: After stealing the Louisiana Purchase and kidnapping Cardin, Tribeca and A.J. are wanted fugitives. Tribeca goes undercover one last time to expose Vice President Perry.

awards: Nominated for 2 Primetime Emmys. 2 nominations total
